book.rpmedicine.guide.landing: A handbook of RP Medicine: wounds, drugs, blood, diagnostics, hospital and surgery.$(br2)Values in $(#b5531f)colour$() can be changed by the server config — the defaults are shown here.
book.rpmedicine.guide.name: Medic's Handbook
item.rpmedicine.adrenaline.desc: With CPR restarts the heart, raises blood pressure. Harmful when healthy.
item.rpmedicine.adrenaline.label: 1 mg/ml
item.rpmedicine.adrenaline.what: An injector pen with adrenaline, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.airway.what: A plastic tube for the mouth or nose.
item.rpmedicine.ambu_bag.desc: Hold right click: breathes for the patient.
item.rpmedicine.ambu_bag.what: A breathing bag with a mask.
item.rpmedicine.amoxicillin.desc: Pills: antibiotic for 8 hours online, once every 8 hours. Medicine 4+.
item.rpmedicine.antibiotic_ointment.desc: Treats infection of a shallow wound or a burn. Medicine 2+.
item.rpmedicine.antiseptic.desc: Wash a wound: 70% lower chance of infection.
item.rpmedicine.antiseptic.what: A bottle of 0.05% chlorhexidine for washing wounds.
item.rpmedicine.atropine.desc: Injection: speeds up a slow heart rate. Medicine 5+.
item.rpmedicine.atropine.label: 1 mg/ml
item.rpmedicine.atropine.what: An injector pen with atropine, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.bandage.desc: Light and moderate bleeding; the wound heals faster.
item.rpmedicine.blood_bag.desc: Transfusion: real blood that carries oxygen. Check the blood type! Spoils outside a fridge.
item.rpmedicine.blood_draw_syringe.desc: Draws blood into an empty test tube (needed in the inventory) for the lab. Medicine 2+.
item.rpmedicine.blood_sample.desc: Full analysis at a lab table in a minute.
item.rpmedicine.bone_saw.desc: Amputates an opened limb: arm, leg (with the foot), foot. The stump is sutured. Medicine 8+.
item.rpmedicine.ceftriaxone.desc: Injection: strong antibiotic for 12 hours. Medicine 5+.
item.rpmedicine.ceftriaxone.label: 250 mg/ml
item.rpmedicine.ceftriaxone.what: An antibiotic vial, 2 doses, drawn with a syringe.
item.rpmedicine.chest_drain.desc: On an opened chest: removes a pneumothorax for good. Medicine 7+.
item.rpmedicine.chlorhexidine_concentrat: Dilute with water in a crafting grid: 1 water bottle — 0.5% for skin, 2 — 0.2% for hands, 3 — 0.05% for wounds.
item.rpmedicine.chlorhexidine_hands.desc: Right-click to wash your hands before an exam or a procedure.
item.rpmedicine.chlorhexidine_hands.what: A bottle of 0.2% chlorhexidine for washing hands.
item.rpmedicine.chlorhexidine_skin.desc: Disinfect the skin before an injection or surgery: right-click for yourself, right-click a person for them.
item.rpmedicine.chlorhexidine_skin.what: A bottle of 0.5% chlorhexidine for skin prep.
item.rpmedicine.cyclosporine.desc: Immunosuppressant: stops rejection of a transplanted organ for 12 hours. Medicine 4+.
item.rpmedicine.cyclosporine.what: An injector pen with cyclosporine, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.decompression_needle.wha: A long thick needle with a catheter.
item.rpmedicine.defibrillator.desc: Treats fibrillation. Does not work on a stopped heart.
item.rpmedicine.diazepam.desc: Injection: eases pain shock and heart rate, drowsiness. With opioids depresses breathing. Medicine 5+.
item.rpmedicine.diazepam.label: 5 mg/ml
item.rpmedicine.diazepam.what: An injector pen with diazepam, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.dirty_syringe.desc: Not sterile. A sterilizer (right-click) makes it clean again.
item.rpmedicine.dirty_test_tube.desc: After a test. A sterilizer (right-click) makes it clean again.
item.rpmedicine.empty_blood_bag.desc: Collects 450 ml of blood from a donor. The donor stands still for 30 s. Medicine 3+.
item.rpmedicine.endotracheal_tube.desc: Intubates an unconscious person (needs a laryngoscope): airway secured, an operating table breathes for them. Medicine 6+.
item.rpmedicine.esmarch.desc: Like a tourniquet but may tear. Single use.
item.rpmedicine.field_surgery_kit.desc: Stops internal bleeding. Temporary stage 1 item.
item.rpmedicine.filled_syringe.desc: Right-click to inject into a vein (or a catheter port). A drip drug — right-click the bag on the IV stand.
item.rpmedicine.glucose_tablets.desc: Raises blood sugar at once — for hypoglycemia.
item.rpmedicine.gm_scanner.desc: Shows everything in numbers. GM only.
item.rpmedicine.hemoanalyzer.desc: A drop of blood (needs a lancet): blood type, hemoglobin, signs of infection and sepsis. Medicine 4+.
item.rpmedicine.hemostat.desc: Clamps the vessels of an opened part: bleeding almost stops. Medicine 7+.
item.rpmedicine.hemostatic_gauze.desc: Heavy and arterial bleeding; the wound does not reopen.
item.rpmedicine.ibuprofen.desc: Pills: pain relief, lowers fever, concussion passes faster. No more than 3 a day.
item.rpmedicine.insulin.desc: Lowers blood sugar by about 6 mmol/L over 2 hours. Can be self-injected.
item.rpmedicine.insulin.label: 10 IU/ml
item.rpmedicine.iv_amino_acids.desc: Into a saline bag on the stand: protein over a 20-minute drip. Needs RP Culinary. Medicine 3+.
item.rpmedicine.iv_amino_acids.label: 10%, into a saline bag
item.rpmedicine.iv_amino_acids.what: A 10 ml vial — a full serving, drawn with a syringe.
item.rpmedicine.iv_catheter.desc: Goes into an arm. The IV stand drips through it. Walk beyond the hose and it gets torn out.
item.rpmedicine.iv_catheter.what: A plastic cannula with a needle.
item.rpmedicine.iv_glucose.desc: Into a saline bag on the stand: calories and sugar over a 20-minute drip. Poor appetite afterwards. Needs RP Culinary. Medicine 3+.
item.rpmedicine.iv_glucose.label: 40%, into a saline bag
item.rpmedicine.iv_glucose.what: A 10 ml vial — a full serving, drawn with a syringe.
item.rpmedicine.iv_lipids.desc: Into a saline bag on the stand: fat and lots of calories over a 20-minute drip. Needs RP Culinary. Medicine 3+.
item.rpmedicine.iv_lipids.label: 20%, into a saline bag
item.rpmedicine.iv_lipids.what: A 10 ml vial — a full serving, drawn with a syringe.
item.rpmedicine.iv_stand.desc: Right-click with a bag to hang it. Empty hand: take the hose, then right-click a patient with a catheter. Shift+right-click: take a bag off.
item.rpmedicine.iv_vitamins.desc: Into a saline bag on the stand: vitamins over a 20-minute drip. Needs RP Culinary. Medicine 3+.
item.rpmedicine.iv_vitamins.label: into a saline bag
item.rpmedicine.iv_vitamins.what: A 10 ml vial — a full serving, drawn with a syringe.
item.rpmedicine.ketamine.desc: Field anesthesia for 5 minutes: unconscious, breathes on their own, raises blood pressure. Medicine 7+.
item.rpmedicine.ketamine.label: 50 mg/ml
item.rpmedicine.ketamine.what: An injector pen with ketamine, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.ketorolac.desc: Injection: moderate pain relief for 20 minutes. Medicine 3+.
item.rpmedicine.ketorolac.label: 30 mg/ml
item.rpmedicine.ketorolac.what: An injector pen with ketorolac, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.lab_report.desc: Right-click to read. To the medical record — the “Attach test” button in the patient's record.
item.rpmedicine.lancet.desc: A drop of blood for the hemoanalyzer.
item.rpmedicine.laryngoscope.desc: Needed in the inventory for intubation.
item.rpmedicine.lidocaine.desc: Local anesthesia of the injected body part for 20 minutes: pain is barely felt, surgery is possible. Medicine 4+.
item.rpmedicine.lidocaine.label: 20 mg/ml (2%)
item.rpmedicine.lidocaine.what: An injector pen with lidocaine, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.lr_ai2.desc: A painkiller from a personal medkit.
item.rpmedicine.lr_cms.desc: Field surgery: stop bleeding, remove fragments.
item.rpmedicine.lr_goldenstar.desc: Works as an antiseptic on a wound.
item.rpmedicine.lr_vaseline.desc: Works as an antibiotic ointment on a shallow wound.
item.rpmedicine.medcard.desc: Blank: right click a player to bind it to them, right click the air for your own. Bound: right click to open.
item.rpmedicine.morphine.desc: Strong pain relief for 15 minutes; depresses breathing, a second dose is dangerous.
item.rpmedicine.morphine.label: 10 mg/ml
item.rpmedicine.morphine.what: An injector pen with morphine, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.naloxone.desc: Injection: instantly reverses opioids — both pain relief and breathing depression. Medicine 4+.
item.rpmedicine.naloxone.label: 0.4 mg/ml
item.rpmedicine.naloxone.what: An injector pen with naloxone, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.norepinephrine.desc: Drip: raises blood pressure for 20 minutes. The patient stays still. Medicine 6+.
item.rpmedicine.norepinephrine.label: 1 mg/ml, for a drip
item.rpmedicine.norepinephrine.what: A norepinephrine vial, 2 doses, drawn with a syringe.
item.rpmedicine.organ.desc: Transplant in place of a missing organ. Incompatible blood — rejection, needs cyclosporine. Spoils in an hour outside a fridge. Medicine 10+.
item.rpmedicine.organ_container.desc: Removes an organ from an opened chest or abdomen (several — choose). Medicine 9+.
item.rpmedicine.osteosynthesis_kit.desc: Plates and screws; used up by the drill.
item.rpmedicine.painkillers.desc: Mild pain relief for 10 minutes, kicks in after a minute.
item.rpmedicine.paracetamol.desc: Pills: mild pain relief, lowers fever. No more than 4 a day.
item.rpmedicine.peg_leg.desc: On a healed leg stump: much slower, no sprinting. Medicine 7+.
item.rpmedicine.portable_scanner.desc: On a body part: internal bleeding, bullets and fragments, fracture, dislocation. Medicine 4+.
item.rpmedicine.propofol.desc: General anesthesia for 10 minutes. Depresses breathing — needs intubation and a table, or a bag valve mask. Medicine 7+.
item.rpmedicine.propofol.label: 10 mg/ml (1%), for a drip
item.rpmedicine.propofol.what: A propofol vial, 2 doses, drawn with a syringe.
item.rpmedicine.prosthetic_foot.desc: On a healed foot stump: slower walking. Medicine 7+.
item.rpmedicine.prosthetic_hook.desc: On a healed arm stump: the arm works at half strength but holds. Medicine 7+.
item.rpmedicine.retractor.desc: Opens a clamped wound for special steps: sutures for bleeding and organs, vascular suture, osteosynthesis, chest drain, tweezers. Medicine 7+.
item.rpmedicine.saline.desc: Restores blood volume. The patient must lie or stand still.
item.rpmedicine.saline.what: A saline bag with a line.
item.rpmedicine.scalpel.desc: Opens a body part. The patient must be unconscious, under local anesthesia of that part, or restrained. Without pain relief — severe pain. Medicine 7+.
item.rpmedicine.severed_limb.desc: A severed body part. Spoils; lasts longer in a fridge.
item.rpmedicine.splint.desc: Fixes a fracture: less pain, heals, movement does not worsen it.
item.rpmedicine.stabilization_kit.desc: Oxygen and an anti-shock pack: a downed patient holds on longer until a medic arrives. Once per knockdown.
item.rpmedicine.stabilization_kit.what: An oxygen can and an anti-shock pack.
item.rpmedicine.stethoscope.desc: Breathing and heart in words: crackles, weak breathing, irregular rhythm. Medicine 2+.
item.rpmedicine.surgical_drill.desc: Osteosynthesis on an opened part (needs an osteosynthesis kit): the fracture heals three times faster, no splint needed. Medicine 8+.
item.rpmedicine.surgical_gloves.desc: In the surgeon's inventory: less infection during surgery.
item.rpmedicine.surgical_mask.desc: Wear it (right click): less infection during surgery.
item.rpmedicine.surgical_tweezers.desc: Removes a bullet or fragment. Without pain relief — pain shock. Not sterile after use — use a sterilizer. Medicine 4+.
item.rpmedicine.suture_kit.desc: Sutures a wound: bleeding stops, heals twice as fast. Remove bullets first. Medicine 3+.
item.rpmedicine.suture_kit.what: Suture material and instruments for stitching.
item.rpmedicine.syringe.desc: With a drug ampoule a medic chooses the dose: half, standard, one and a half, double. Used up per injection. Medicine 4+.
item.rpmedicine.test_tube.desc: For drawing blood with a syringe: becomes a blood sample.
item.rpmedicine.tourniquet.desc: Stops blood flow in an arm or leg. Harms the limb after 15 minutes.
item.rpmedicine.tramadol.desc: Pills: moderate pain relief for 40 minutes, slightly depresses breathing. Opioid. Medicine 4+.
item.rpmedicine.txa.desc: Slows internal and external bleeding for 10 minutes.
item.rpmedicine.txa.label: 1000 mg/ml
item.rpmedicine.txa.what: An injector pen with tranexamic acid, 4 doses.
item.rpmedicine.used_iv_bag.desc: An empty IV bag. Throw it away.
item.rpmedicine.vascular_suture.desc: Repairs an artery on an opened part: arterial bleeding stops, the tourniquet can come off. Medicine 8+.

rpmedicine.minigame.hint_amputation: Saw with steady left-right strokes, staying in the cut line.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_auscultation: Hold LMB and put the chestpiece on the yellow point — keep it there while listening. Front and back.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_bandage: Hold LMB and circle in the shown direction — it changes. Don't rush and stay on the line
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_bleed_suture: Keep the needle on the source until it is sutured: it moves with each heartbeat.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_bp_cuff: Wheel up — pump the cuff. Then it deflates (LMB — faster). Space or RMB — when the sounds start, and again when they stop.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_clamp: Click the bleeding points between spurts.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_close: Stitches: press at the yellow dot and pull the thread to its pair without straying.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_drain: Hit the gap between the ribs and push the tube with even force.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_drill: Aim the drill at a plate hole and drill keeping the force in the green zone. Four screws.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_extract: Move every bullet and fragment to the tray with the tweezers.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_harvest: Cut the vessels between spurts, then move the organ into the container.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_incision: Press at the green mark and draw the scalpel along the line, steady and slow.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_injection: Aim the needle at the injection site and click. Then hold LMB and press the plunger evenly — inside the moving green zone
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_intubation: Aim the tube at the gap between the vocal cords and click when they open; advance on each breath, keep it centred.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_organ_suture: Small stitches across the organ tear.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_plant: Place the organ, then suture the vessel without leaving the channel.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_reduce: Hold LMB: traction in the green zone. Then jerk (LMB or Space) when the marker is in the window
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_retract: Grab a wound edge and slowly pull it to the green mark — one, then the other.
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_suture: Hold LMB on the yellow point, pull the thread to its pair and release. Don't drift sideways
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_tourniquet: LMB tightens, release loosens. Keep the marker in the moving green zone, don't overtighten
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_tweezers: Hold LMB at the green mark, reach the bullet and pull it back out along the channel without touching the walls
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_vein: Hold LMB at the green mark and guide the needle along the vein without touching the walls. Then hold still
rpmedicine.minigame.hint_vessel: Lead the thread from one end of the artery to the other without leaving the channel.
rpmedicine.minigame.jerk: Jerk — when the marker is in the green!
rpmedicine.minigame.tighten: Pull the edges together: hold LMB, release when they meet
rpmedicine.minigame.tissue_torn: Pulled too hard — the tissue tore
